name: Katsuragi Shou
source:
Katsuragi Shou is the protagonist of the game. He's a high school student who has recently transferred into the Ootori Ryouran Gakuen. He’s generally a nice person and he loves to eat.

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2010/12/11/flyable-heart-review/]Calamitous Intent's review[/url] and [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flyable_Heart]Wikipedia[/url]]
